Marian came to school with a new bag. It was red, and it had a small pocket in front. Her friends looked at it and smiled. "Where did you get it?" asked Juan. "My ate gave it to me — it was her gift," said Marian. At recess they sat under the big tree. They shared bread and sang a song. The bell rang, and they ran back to class. The teacher read a story about a boy from Manila. Marian listened and held her bag close.
